caveats: The Q4 value is derived (not reported directly): full-year FY2026 revenue of $303.154 billion less the $207.431 billion year-to-date figure through 2026-05-10, from the filings cited in the derivation.
Fiscal Q4 2026 is shown in the evidence as running 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30.

claims.text: Costco's total revenue in fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30) was about $95.72 billion (95,723,000,000 USD), derived as fiscal-year revenue of 303,154,000,000 minus 207,431,000,000 for the period through 2026-05-10.

raw_output.summary: Costco's total revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (May 11 to August 30, 2026) was about $95.72 billion. This is a derived figure: fiscal-year revenue minus the year-to-date figure through the end of Q3.
